messages:
Alex: Quick sync re: Barcelona ML Meetup in 3 weeks — trade show table A4. Need final swag qty, deck, demo network plan by Mon 2025-10-20. Who's in?

Maya: I'll handle swag. Thinking: 600 stickers, 150 tees, 120 tote bags, 250 postcards. ETA to SF: 2025-10-28.

Samir: Talk accepted: "Optimizing inference cost at scale" 25m talk. I'll bring slides. Need AV: HDMI, clicker, lapel. Will rehearse Tue 3pm.

Liz: For demos: two modes — cloud live (needs reliable WAN) and offline quantized on local box. Prefer local. @Evan please do hotspot/backhaul.

Evan: Lead capture plan: Airtable form + QR + team phone NFC. GDPR checkbox + country field. CSV offline fallback. Shortlink: https://rbwd.in/bcn-demo (WIP).

Jules: Volunteers: I can do setup morning + teardown. Can we get 2 more for midday?

Marco: I can cover midday Sat and handle crates pickup from SF office to carrier on Fri.

Finance: Budget cap €7k for swag. If tees push us over, need approval.

Maya: OK switching tees to 100, add 80 enamel pins and 50 mini powerbanks (note: powerbanks may trigger customs).

Alex: Decision: 100 tees, 80 pins, 50 powerbanks. Maya proceed with PO. Keep total under €7k; ping Finance if not.

Samir: Slides: include one anonymized perf chart vs major providers + callouts for Dedicated & Private + CTA to book POC.

Liz: AV checklist: HDMI, adapter kit (EU/UK), table, 2 chairs, power strip, ethernet port. Request wired for demos.

Evan: QR tags: event:bcn, product:(Hosted|Dedicated|Private), demo_interest:yes/no. Also add utm params for campaign.

Alex: Shift roster draft:
Sat 09:00-12:00 (Maya, Alex, Jules)
Sat 12:00-16:00 (Liz, Samir, Marco)
Sun 09:00-12:00 (Evan, Maya)
Sun 12:00-15:00 (Alex, Liz)
Any swaps?

Samir: Can swap Sun afternoon with Marco.

Maya: Packing checklist (draft): crates x2, banners x2, tablecloth, MacBook Pro (demo), devbox (GPU), dongles, HDMI, ethernet, printed postcards x250, stickers, tees, pins, powerbanks, toolkit.

OpsBot: Reminder scheduled: book carrier by 2025-10-22. Shipment tracking to follow.

Alex: I'll put together a runbook in Notion and share link by EOD. Any blockers?

Jules: Need travel stipend confirmation for volunteers.

Finance: Travel stipend approved. Send volunteer list.

Maya: PO submitted. Expected arrival at SF 2025-10-28. Final packing list by 2025-10-30.

Evan: Form & QR live tomorrow. Shortlink https://rbwd.in/bcn-demo final.

Alex: Thanks team :rocket: Locking plan unless there are blockers by EOD.
